Name: Fiz
Description: During the Ages of Apocalypse event, a dying Apocalypse attempted to bend reality using the Twelve. He attempted to trick them into to powering himself and allowing him to insert himself into a younger body, One such reality was a future where the X-Men had conquered space. The Cadre K had spread peace through the Cosmos, and working with the Professor and Beast, they had worked out a way to feed Galactus. Fiz appeared to be very high up within the workings of the Space-Based X-Men, and was there to greet Xavier, the Founder-X, Storm and Colossus as they returned from the Negative Zone.
